summary: Committed 9fad9a7fb84b8d4c71b195842845eb5889225ca9: added Client.ProjectCapacityExclusionTransition.excludeTransition as the narrow counterpart to W16 beginTransition. It delegates to the existing W21 ProjectCapacityAdmission.excludeHeldBeforeSend on the caller-supplied LedgerBinding and exact original/effect/actor/role/roleVersion/generation tuple. Fresh CAS commit maps to Committed; LedgerStore AlreadyApplied maps to Replay (observation only, never a second release). The operation shares the project-capacity state blob/authority with beginTransition and changes only the exact Held entry. The adapter remains internal and deliberately absent from Client.fsproj: this task does not add an auth route, role binder, production bootstrap or activation. Boundary: only send paths that commit beginTransition against this same project ledger before their first external effect are fenced; nonparticipating paths and provider terminal outcomes are not proven, and timeout/transport error/tab close/dead agent must never be treated as no-send. Focused disposable-clone suite passed 13/13; separate no-fixture-symbol compile-only project built successfully. Only warning was pre-existing FS0760 in Client/Program.fs.
nextAction: Caller handoff for the separate ownership boundary: Worker 19 owns Client.fsproj and Program runtime composition, so it must add ProjectCapacityAdmission.fs, ProjectCapacityDispatchTransition.fs and ProjectCapacityExclusionTransition.fs to the common client compilation boundary under its existing lease, bind actor from the existing authenticated client identity, and call excludeTransition with the same LedgerBinding used by beginTransition. Worker 23 owns its native project no-send issuer/caller and should coordinate its call through that shared client boundary without editing Client.fsproj or creating a competing project-capacity writer/authentication path. Both callers must preserve the exact original/effect/role/version/generation lineage and use a unique operation id; Committed means this exact Held reservation was excluded, Replay means the original receipt was observed, and an error/lost race to Dispatching leaves capacity occupied. W19 must prove its first external effect follows the shared beginTransition CAS; until then the guarantee is explicitly limited to participating paths. No production activation, post-send terminal proof or cutover is included.
